info.title: ERP External Read-only API
info.description: Read-only server-to-server API. Credentials managed through Settings / API Access. All amounts are decimal strings, all queries scoped to key organization. HTTPS required outside local development. No browser-embedded secrets. P1–P6 read resources. No payroll, bank, identity or business write APIs. New scopes are opt-in. Party/HR/document policies apply; full reconciliation is required for deletions and access changes.

servers.description: Replace with deployment base URL (including subdirectory, if any)

get.description: Required integration scope: summary:sales:read. Organization is derived from the credential; user sessions do not authenticate this endpoint. Dates must be supplied together, inclusive, at most 366 days. Default current month in organization timezone. Unknown filters including org_id and branch_id are rejected. No pagination. Current-status cohorts by customer/deal created_at and quotation issue_date, original currency groups.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Supply both dates or neither. Inclusive organization-local business date.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Supply both dates or neither. Inclusive organization-local business date.

200.description: Live summary. Empty monetary groups are [] and counts are 0.

401.description: Invalid/expired/revoked key or inactive organization

403.description: Missing endpoint scope

404.description: Unknown endpoint

405.description: Unsupported method

422.description: Unsupported filters, malformed dates, inverted or over 366-day period

426.description: HTTPS required in production

429.description: Rate limit exceeded

500.description: Sanitized internal error

get.description: Required integration scope: summary:finance:read. Organization is derived from the credential; user sessions do not authenticate this endpoint. Dates must be supplied together, inclusive, at most 366 days. Default current month in organization timezone. Unknown filters including org_id and branch_id are rejected. No pagination. get.summary: Read organization projects and tasks summary
get.description: Requires summary:projects:read. Existing keys do not gain the new scope automatically. Date filters apply to created_at cohorts and done tasks completed_at, with organization-local day boundaries. Snapshot status/progress/overdue counts are current, independent of period. Active projects: planning/active/on_hold. Overdue tasks: todo/in_progress with due_date before today; blocked excluded. Tasks require a live project in the same organization. No names, people, budgets, costs or work hours. currency_mode: not_applicable. See EXTERNAL_SUMMARY_API.md.

401.description: HTTP 401; sanitized error. Retry-After applies to 429.

403.description: HTTP 403; sanitized error. Retry-After applies to 429.

404.description: HTTP 404; sanitized error. Retry-After applies to 429.

405.description: HTTP 405; sanitized error. Retry-After applies to 429.

409.description: HTTP 409; sanitized error. Retry-After applies to 429.

422.description: HTTP 422; sanitized error. Retry-After applies to 429.

426.description: HTTP 426; sanitized error. Retry-After applies to 429.

429.description: HTTP 429; sanitized error. Retry-After applies to 429.

500.description: HTTP 500; sanitized error. Retry-After applies to 429.

average_active_project_progress_percent.description: Unweighted mean stored progress for planning/active/on_hold, one decimal HALF_UP; null for no active projects.

post.description: OUTBOUND callback on receiver, NOT an ERP write API. At-least-once; dedupe id, verify HMAC(timestamp + dot + exact bytes), enforce5m replay window then fetch current scoped data. Live dispatch disabled by default.
